listing.name: Pokémon: Let’s Go, Eevee! (letsgo-recomp)
listing.summary: Experimental AArch64 to C static host code and LAS-derived Vulkan runtime. Upstream maturity: WIP, no full playthrough; Eevee1.0.0 most tested, Pikachu less. Online/PokéBallPlus/second player unsupported. Higher FPS, frame generation and wild battles experimental. Acquisition: Actual Windows ZIP launcher imports/copies and recompiles game locally once. One folder per game. Platforms: Windows10/11 x64 SSE4.2, AVX2 recommended, Vulkan1.3. No other native desktop route established. Original data: Own corresponding Eevee or Pikachu extracted ExeFS/RomFS, any region. Base1.0.0 offers all options;1.0.1/1.0.2 accepted with fewer options/less testing. XCI/NSP must be extracted first. Separate keys/firmware not described after extraction. Portcove setup/gameplay untested; no operational integration offered.
